gold_row.question: Gib alle Messwerte von Sensor 2.0 in Epoche 17 aus.
gold_row.gold_answer: Dazu liegen mir keine Daten vor.
gold_row.gold_cypher:
MATCH (s:Sensor {mote_id: 2})-[:GENERATED]->(m:Measurement)
MATCH (m)-[:EPOCH_IN]->(e:Epoch {epoch_id: 17})
WITH m, s
RETURN coalesce(s.mote_id, m.moteid, m.mote_id) AS mote_id, m.time AS time, m.temperature AS temperature, m.humidity AS humidity, m.light AS light, m.voltage AS voltage ORDER BY time, mote_id LIMIT 20
